爱莎贝儿娃主返图-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD024 渡边由乃Watanabe Yuno-偷来的香气 by 爱莉耶
“姐姐的衣服…我穿会不会太大？” 她故意让肩带滑落，眨着眼等你回答。
你伸手想帮她拉好，指尖却停在了她温热的皮肤上。
“我身上有姐姐的香水味哦。” 她凑近，你闻到熟悉的香气，此刻却混着她特有的气息。
这不该有的念头让你耳根发烫。
身型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe doll owner's photo sharing-148CM-L Pink RAD024 Watanabe Yuno-Stolen Scent by Arie
"Sister's clothes...are they too big for me?" She deliberately let the strap slip down, blinking as she waited for your answer.
You reached out to help her adjust them, but your fingertips stopped at her warm skin.
"I smell my sister's perfume on me." She leaned closer, and you smelled the familiar scent, now mixed with her unique aroma.
This inappropriate thought made your ears burn.
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
